Expose arena-backed document/index data via lifetimes tied to &self; prefer self_cell owner/dependent internals and treat explicit 'static + doc_arena_ptr() ownership-transfer seams as deprecated transition-only paths with documented SAFETY
Incremental LSP edit handling should centralize byte-range clamping and surface clamp events via warning telemetry
Incremental wiki-link work should start with parity/edge tests before selective merge optimizations
When prompt arguments document defaults, enforce that default explicitly at handler boundary before dispatching CoreOperation
Incremental wiki-link fast path must detect edits beyond last old link range and force recomputation to avoid stale append-tail indexing
codeStyle.bash: set -euo pipefail, jq for JSON, case statements for file extension matching

codePatterns: DocumentArena wrapper preferred over raw Bump for per-document arenas (Debug, capacity)
ArenaHashMap is !Send (Bump:!Sync); parser types can use it, index types must use std HashMap

Self-referential arena migration path: use DocumentArena as owner with self_cell owner/dependent internals; legacy 'static + doc_arena_ptr() ownership-transfer is deprecated and should not be introduced in new code
RealmIndex cross-doc maps remain owned String-backed until self_cell/ouroboros migration (marky-5yt); do not introduce borrowed Cow across sibling fields
Use compile_fail doctests on public methods to lock lifetime leakage invariants during migration work
Use self_cell owner/dependent internals as a first stable migration step when replacing internal static-marked self-references
For LSP incremental edits, pair out-of-range clamping with a deterministic warning so buggy clients are observable during diagnostics
Use pending InputEdit lifecycle tracking in ServerState as shared incremental infrastructure before extractor-specific merge logic
